raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Carry Kimi K3's attention-residual blocks inside the model as a list of [T, D] tensors instead of a [T, N, D] stack, so a block opening appends a reference instead of building a longer copy, and the activation checkpoints of later layers share the same blocks.

- `kimi_k3/model.py`: the blocks are a list; `_apply_attention_residual` stacks it inside the call, so the arithmetic is unchanged. The model's forward still takes and returns the stack, so the pipeline stage is unchanged.
- `kimi_k3/sharding.py`: the layer 0 boundary of the multimodal decoder converts no stack, since the list starts empty.

## Design

Every block opening used to concatenate a longer stack, and each layer's checkpoint kept the stack it was called with, so under full, selective or region activation checkpointing every shorter copy stayed alive until backward: for 24 layers in blocks of 4 the checkpoints held 21 [T, D] units where the blocks are 6. A checkpoint keeps its inputs by reference, so with a list every checkpoint references the same six blocks.

## Results

### Memory

This PR `7dea4cbaf` against main `838e6962e` on one H100 (80 GB): `kimi_k3_debugmodel` (dim 256, 17 layers, attention residual blocks of 4), AdamW, bf16, `seed=42`, deterministic, 262144 tokens per step in 65536-token micro-batches, 10 steps; each pair runs on copies of one inductor cache warmed by both trees. Peak memory is the max reserved memory; one [T, D] block is 32 MiB here.

| activation checkpointing | peak memory main | peak memory this PR | step 1 loss / grad norm | step 10 loss / grad norm | steps equal to main (loss and grad norm) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- | ---: |
| none | 39.65 GiB | 39.46 GiB | `8.10837` / `2.0312` | `3.76747` / `2.5625` | 10 / 10 |
| selective (the flavor default) | 12.30 GiB | 12.05 GiB | `8.10837` / `2.0312` | `3.76747` / `2.5625` | 10 / 10 |
| full | 6.16 GiB | 5.86 GiB | `8.10837` / `2.0312` | `3.76747` / `2.5625` | 10 / 10 |
| region | 6.16 GiB | 5.87 GiB | `8.10837` / `2.0312` | `3.76747` / `2.5625` | 10 / 10 |

### TP and SP numerics

Verifies numerical correctness under TP and SP: this PR against main `838e6962e` on four H100s, the same debug model with AdamW, `seed=42`, deterministic, 100 steps, each configuration on copies of one inductor cache warmed by both trees. The model memorises the debug set after about step 40, so the table shows steps 1, 10 and 20.

| parallelism | GPUs | tokens per step | activation checkpointing | main loss, steps 1 / 10 / 20 | main grad norm, steps 1 / 10 / 20 | steps equal to main (loss and grad norm) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| none | 1 | 256 | selective | `8.19951` / `3.61554` / `3.29465` | `2.5469` / `2.5156` / `3.1875` | 100 / 100 |
| none, main again on a fresh copy of the cache | 1 | 256 | selective | `8.19951` / `3.61554` / `3.29465` | `2.5469` / `2.5156` / `3.1875` | 100 / 100 |
| tp2 x ep2, SP on | 2 | 256 | selective | `8.21344` / `3.66909` / `3.27307` | `2.5469` / `2.5625` / `3.0625` | 100 / 100 |
| tp2 x ep2, SP off | 2 | 256 | selective | `8.21337` / `3.66648` / `3.25369` | `2.5469` / `2.5625` / `3.0625` | 100 / 100 |
| dp2 x tp2 x ep2, SP on | 4 | 512 | selective | `8.20101` / `3.51541` / `3.12135` | `2.4062` / `2.2500` / `1.7266` | 100 / 100 |
| `kimi_k3_debugmodel_mm` (dp2 x tp2 x ep2, SP on), type checking off | 4 | 4096 | none | `8.20178` / `3.54356` / `3.11267` | `2.3906` / `2.3594` / `1.7969` | 100 / 100 |

## Test plan

- `pytest tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_kimi_k3_pp_layout.py tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_kimi_k3_pp_stage.py tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_kimi_k3_pp_block_grads.py tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_moe.py tests/unit_tests/cpu/test_transforms.py -q` (62 passed; the PP tests need a torch nightly from 2026-10-03 or later)

## Relation to earlier revisions of this PR

Earlier revisions also recomputed the attention residual in backward under `torch_remat`; that part is dropped, as suggested in review.
